verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services and business-formation provider. User-authored automations that can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back fall outside that product category, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows a user-configurable automation builder. The only items that come close are built-in features such as deadline reminders, compliance notifications and mileage capture, which are not user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
